note: Local speech input assets (transformers.js, ONNX Runtime WASM, a Whisper model). Not in git and not shipped. Obtain them from a source you trust, put them in Web/vendor/voice (or the folder named by PACKETRAT_VOICE_DIR), then list every file here as {"name": "transformers.min.js", "sha256": "<64 hex>"}. The server serves only listed files whose SHA-256 still matches. See docs/VOICE.md.
